G1–G10: graphics and sound pack

2026-10-26 · local builds side by side (before = commit be0312c on :5201, after = this change on :5001), Azurite, every paid or external API faked in Playwright, installed Chrome on an Adreno X1-85 (real WebGL2 and WebGPU), effects tier set to Full.

#What changedSeen here?
G1The generation wait is a chord that gains a voice per pipeline phase, with a texture per phase (pages, thought, pencil, lettering, press), and ink pips under the step line. The chord sags on failure.Pips: yes. Sound: no
G2The score ring is a damped spring: stranger means less damping, a harder overshoot and a longer wobble, voiced by a continuous needle tone instead of ticks.Chart below
G3The backdrop melts past ~55 and ripples once when the score lands. Also fixed: the backdrop was never visible (body's background painted over it), and its float hash tore into vertical seams on this GPU.Yes
G4Map pins drop in nearest-first with a squash-and-stretch landing; the first eight pluck where they land.Landing squash
G5The account menu is a glass sheet; on a phone it rises and its scrim blurs in.Yes
G6The CERTIFIED STRANGE stamp throws ink droplets that splat, with a wet splash sound.Yes
G7The "Too normal" card sags notch by notch with the trombone, drains to grey, then perks back up.Yes
G8Comics scoring 80+ wear a holographic foil that slides and tilts toward the pointer or tilt light.Yes
G9Map sounds (new switch, off by default): wind from camera speed, a ping when "Search this area" appears, a hum from the drawn places.Switch only
G10Ink motes (new switch, off by default, WebGPU only): a compute-shader particle field behind the comic, parting around the pointer.Yes

G2 · the score needle

The ring's value, sampled every ~60ms while a 92 lands. Before: a CSS ease straight to 92. After: it pegs at 100 (the overshoot is clamped), swings back to 85, rings up to 94 and settles. The early flat stretch is page-load main-thread time, not the spring.

Before After

G3 · G8 · G10 · comic page (score 92)

After: the backdrop field finally shows behind the page, ink motes drift over it, and the strip wears the foil and leans toward the pointer (top right). Before: a flat lavender page, because the shader was hidden.

G6 · share stamp

Share pressed, 480ms later. After: ink thrown off the stamp, some still in flight (stretched), some already splatted.

G1 · the wait

Step 1 of 5. After: five pips; the current one splats in as its voice joins the chord.

G7 · too normal to draw

1.5s in. After: the card has sagged and drained to grey in time with the trombone; it perks back up by 2.6s.

G4 · map pins

A second search with the map already up. After: undrawn pins caught squashing as they land. A still cannot show the fall itself.

G5 · account sheet (phone)

After: a glass sheet over a blurred scrim.

G9 · G10 · settings (phone)

After: a "Map sounds" switch under Sound and an "Ink motes" switch under Visual effects (shown only where WebGPU exists; On here only because the capture switched it on, it defaults Off).

Also in this change

  • Deleted 8 effect modules nothing imported any more: ai-voice, depth-diorama, duel-seam, halftone-reveal, ink-fluid, page-curl, particles, sticker.
  • Not visible in stills: all of the sound (G1 chord, G2 needle tone, G4 plucks, G6 splash, G9 wind, ping and hum) and the motion of the melt, ripple and motes.
